limitations: No paid model, live provider, real desktop/email/payment effect or hosted deployment certification.
Default asynchronous child workflows intentionally remain independent; opt in for required completion. Child outputs are not copied into the parent, only identity/status/outcome.
Continuation/recovery uses the existing timer tick (normally 15 seconds); completion can precede the next visible parent update.
A crash after durable dispatch claim remains uncertain and is never automatically replayed. No promise of remote rollback on cancellation.
Older binaries ignore waitForCompletion, so downgrade requires the rollback procedure below.
rollback: Cancel or finish all active required parent/child runs before downgrade; remove waitForCompletion from graphs being used by old binaries. Revert Q-10 commits, rebuild pieces and refresh catalog, restart. Keep the additive table and historic receipts. Rollback does not authorize replay of uncertain effects.
